Body.Content:
What and why:

On August 25, 2026, the Microsoft 365 Roadmap will be renamed the AI at Work Roadmap.

The AI at Work Roadmap provides a single destination to discover upcoming innovations across Microsoft 365, Copilot, agents, and related AI-powered experiences. Beginning in September 2026, roadmap information for Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse will also begin publishing to the AI at Work Roadmap, making it easier to track innovation across Microsoft's business applications, productivity, and AI portfolio.

The roadmap continues to support planning and readiness activities by providing visibility into upcoming features and changes.

Rollout Schedule:

  • August 25, 2026: Microsoft 365 Roadmap is renamed to AI at Work Roadmap
  • September 2026: New Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse capabilities begin publishing to the AI at Work Roadmap

Impact on your organization:

Who is affected

  • Microsoft 365 administrators
  • IT professionals
  • Change management teams
  • Technology decision makers who use roadmap information for planning and readiness activities

Platforms/Services

  • AI at Work Roadmap (formerly Microsoft 365 Roadmap)

What will happen

  • The Microsoft 365 Roadmap will be renamed to AI at Work Roadmap on August 25, 2026.
  • Beginning in September 2026, new roadmap content for Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse will begin publishing to the AI at Work Roadmap.
  • Customers will be able to discover roadmap information across Microsoft's business applications, productivity experiences, Copilot, agents, and AI-powered solutions in a single location.
  • Organizations are encouraged to take advantage of roadmap capabilities including filtering, export, RSS, and MCP integration.
  • There are no changes to how customers access, use, or consume roadmap information.
  • Existing roadmap planning and tracking workflows can continue without modification.

Action required / Recommendations:

  • No immediate action is required.
  • We recommend:
    • Reviewing the AI at Work Roadmap once the new panding becomes available.
    • Familiarizing your organization with roadmap capabilities such as filtering, CSV export, RSS subscriptions, and roadmap management best practices using the AI at Work Roadmap Guide.
    • Exploring the Release Communications MCP Server documentation if your organization uses AI-powered workflows or planning tools that consume roadmap data.
    • Updating any internal documentation, bookmarks, training materials, or references that use the Microsoft 365 Roadmap name, as appropriate.
    • Reviewing and updating any existing links to Release Planner or release wave materials as your organization transitions to the AI at Work Roadmap.

Compliance Considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
